run_ensemble_grid_search: run a combinatorial grid search over 1000 sampled configurations for the algonauts 2025 model soup experiment
run_experiment_with_confdict: create a ConfDict from default_config and update it with custom infra and wandb settings before running
run_grid_with_experiment: run the run_grid function with an Experiment class, grid parameters, and combinatorial sampling of 1000 configs
configure_grid_search_parameters: configure grid search parameters including data layers, loss functions, layer aggregation, and modality dropout values
run_model_soup_ensemble: run the model soup ensemble grid search with MSELoss, PearsonLoss, SmoothL1Loss, and HuberLoss options
